name: circshift
comment: Sig: r = circshift(X, K[, dim]). The 3-arg form shifts by K ONLY along dimension `dim`: circshift([1 2 3;4 5 6],1,2)=[3 1 2;6 4 5] (columns), circshift(...,1,1)=[4 5 6;1 2 3] (rows), circshift(...,-1,2)=[2 3 1;5 6 4], circshift([10 20 30 40],2,2)=[30 40 10 20]. numkit previously IGNORED the dim arg and always shifted dim 1; fixed 2026-05-30. The 2-arg scalar form and the [k1 k2] vector form are unchanged. Spec-extension batch 2026-05-09 + dim arg. NOTE: ; only inside matrix-literal INPUTS.
